clues: This Nevada city sits just south east of Las Vegas. It fills a broad, dry valley in the hot south of the state.
This is a hot desert city, yet snow can fall in winter. Summer storms can also strike fast and flood the dry streets.
It was set up as a city in 1953. In the war just before, its plants made magnesium for the war push.
After the PEPCON disaster, this city built back strong. It grew fast with planned new towns, starting with Green Valley.
A web of long trails links its many parks, mile after mile. That green web is a proud mark of this desert city.
